testcase.system-out: Scenario: Filter recent documents by assembly type and clears the filter ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent parts and assemblies are available ✔ And no recent-document filters are active ✔ When the user opens Filter and selects Assembly ✔ Then the recent list displays assembly documents ✔ And the filter control indicates one active filter ✔ When the user chooses Clear filters ✔ Then the Assembly filter is unchecked ✔ And recent parts and assemblies are displayed again
